items.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996
items.q: Jimmy Witherspoon was born in 1923... he met Jay McShann and replaced Walter Brown as Jay‘s vocalist.

ctx.x: Would you do it again? Who did you replace, or did he have a singer before you?
Walter Brown, and he had some other singer for a little while. But really it was Walter Brown.
He had had a few records that were fairly well known, right?
